decisions.story_title: Mirae Asset Securities data breach exposes personal data of 39,000 people
decisions.reason: Real breach disclosure: South Korean brokerage reports data breach affecting around 39,000 people, customer account data exposed. Substantive incident worth covering as a new story.
German trade-press roundup commentary on an OpenAI/Hugging Face AI story; secondary coverage, no primary reporting or new substance.
macOS 26.3 feature change (Live Activities decoupled from Dynamic Island); not a security event, generic product explainer.
BleepingComputer report on the Crédit Mutuel Arkéa breach via a service provider's platform; belongs to the existing French bank heist story (same incident, same service-provider vector).

decisions.story_title: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 exploited within hours of disclosure
decisions.reason: Weekly threat roundup reports OpenSSH SSHole (CVE-2026-123158) exploited within hours of disclosure granting root access on Alpine/musl systems. Observed in-the-wild exploitation claim; no existing candidate story covers this CVE.
Alex Stamos commentary on AI-powered attack tools widening breach scope; opinion piece, no specific incident or advisory substance.

decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-123550 OpenIdentityPlatform OpenAM authentication bypass by spoofing
decisions.reason: Critical authentication bypass in OpenIdentityPlatform OpenAM (CVE-2026-123550) via spoofing. Distinct from the candidate ForgeRock OpenAM CVE-2026-123551 info-disclosure story; new story.

decisions.story_title: Areas Assurances data leak exposes social security numbers of 21,732 policyholders
decisions.reason: French insurer Aréas Assurances data breach exposing NIR social security numbers of 21,732 insureds. Real breach incident with substance; new story.
Generic incident response playbook how-to content hosted on forms.gle; explainer/marketing, no security event.

decisions.story_title: Kaniko flaw CVE-2026-105769 sends Azure Entra ID tokens to lookalike registry hosts, fixed in 1.25.20
decisions.reason: Kaniko versions before 1.25.20 can send a build's Microsoft Entra ID access token to lookalike registry hosts (CVE-2026-105769). Concrete vulnerability with fix version; new story.
Barracuda critical flaws allowing root access to devices; same BleepingComputer advisory already tracked in the existing candidate story.
Muthoot Microfin IT spending increase (40%) amid AI threats; vendor/budget news, no breach or vulnerability substance.
Hungarian-language explainer on Microsoft update risks and AI; generic patch-risk guidance, no specific advisory or incident.
Apiiro research: 2,539 classified credentials found after Claude Code stored app secrets; amplifies the existing Claude Code settings.local.json exposure story.
